headline: Ipswich and Nottingham Forest share points after 1–1 draw

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest drew 1–1 in the Premier League, with both goals arriving before half-time.
Neco Williams put Nottingham Forest ahead in the 13th minute, and Julio Enciso equalised for Ipswich in the 41st.
Nottingham Forest had 17 shots to Ipswich’s 7, but neither side found a second-half goal.
